title: Single Number III
statement: Exactly two values appear once; every other value appears twice. Return the two singles in any order, in linear time and constant extra space.
constraints: exactly two values appear once, the rest appear twice
hints: XOR everything. The pairs cancel, leaving the XOR of the two answers - which is not either answer, but it is not useless either.
Any bit set in that combined XOR is a bit where the two answers DIFFER. Pick one such bit and it splits every value into two groups, with one answer in each.
Take the lowest set bit with x & -x, partition on it, and XOR each group separately. Values that appear twice land in the same group as their twin and cancel, so each group reduces to one answer.

cases.name: answers differ only in the low bit
